description:
Best for: riders who want RAEV’s most refined everyday bike — premium finish, all-day comfort, upgraded suspension and brakes, and dual-battery range for commutes, errands and weekend rides.

RAEV bikes don’t just look good in photos — they look premium in person. From the paint finish to the overall material feel, every detail is designed to deliver a richer, more refined presence on the road.

One of the most praised details by RAEV riders is the seat. It’s wide, supportive, and genuinely comfortable, making longer rides, daily cruising, and relaxed city trips feel noticeably better.

We use Vee Huntsman tires because premium ride quality starts where the bike meets the road. They cost more than generic alternatives, but better grip, better feel, and better confidence are worth it.

The GTX elevates the classic GT silhouette with Honda-inspired engineering and quality. More power, steadier control, and long-range confidence make city rides and weekend two-up trips feel effortless.

Dual batteries provide 33Ah total capacity, with up to 100+ miles of pedal-assist range or up to 50+ miles throttle-only.

Dual battery total 33 Ah with Samsung 21700 cells

Up to 100 plus miles PAS and 50 plus miles throttle

Folding pegs standard for easy two person rides

A 60 mm hydraulic front fork and dual-chamber rear air shock add comfort and control on city streets and light gravel.

Hydraulic front fork 60 mm travel with lockout

Upgraded dual chamber rear air shock

Composed chassis for comfort and control on mixed roads

Upgraded 4 piston hydraulic disc brakes with power cut sensors deliver strong, predictable stopping for heavier loads and two up.

4 piston hydraulic disc brakes with power cut sensors

Predictable modulation less lever effort

Confident braking for loads and two person riding
